main_text.p: ventriculo, vel sunt facilis, vel difficilis concoctionis. Difficulter coquuntur panes fermenti expertes, caro cervina, arietina, bubula, infumata, pisces indurati quocunque modo. & ut verbo dicam, quæcunque nimis sunt terrestria. At panis probè fermentatus, ova tremula, lactuca, spinachia &c. facilis sunt concoctionis. Fructus horarij, cerasa, mala persica, melones, facile corrumpuntur propter aquositatem. pyra verò, mala cydonia, reliquaq; nimis crassæ substantiæ, difficulter corrumpuntur.

Dividi solent alimenta à medicis in boni, & mali succi, hoc est, quædam generant laudabilem sanguinē, quædam non. Laudabilem succum generant panis triticeus bene fermentatus, coctusque in clibano, ova recentia, carnes animalium castratorum &c. perca, merula, multique pisces, exceptis ijs qui in paludibus & stagnis vivunt. at carnes animalium non castratorum, tum vulpinum, asinorum, aviumq; carnivorarum malum sangui-

page.notes: The last word of the page is broken across the line end as "sangui-" and continues on the next page. Some letters in the lower lines are faint, notably in "paludibus" and "vulpinum", but were readable.
